name: Homeward Stone (Millhaven)
description: A warm brown pebble with a key rune, worn smooth from riding on a key ring. It pulls toward the waystone on Millhaven's green.
notes: Use it to teleport to the waystone in Millhaven's town square. It isn't used up.
All Homeward Stones share one charge: after any of them carries you, none works for a week.
Not in a fight, a dungeon or a party. Using one on the road abandons the trip. No time passes.
Sold by the vault keeper in Millhaven.
